# Button script: Field Training's first two missions. Mission 1 as
# tools/field_training_win.txt (to the next briefing by 28000), then mission 2
# against Olaf: Day 1 four infantry attack and two destroy their targets, End;
# Olaf's turn; Day 2 four attacks, End; Olaf's turn; Day 3 the save tutorial,
# then two attacks finish him. Victory (rank A) by ~53000, the third
# mission's briefing by ~54600. Matches mGBA turn for turn.
# A presses stay 15+ frames off text-box edges (0x03001D18 going 0 -> 1, from
# mgba_oracle's ORACLE_WATCH) unless the press itself opens the box: timing
# is within a few frames of mGBA's, not exact.
